# Analysis summary (generated by `python -m triage analyse`)

## Data cleaning
- Read 11780 tickets.
- Shifted legacy resolved_at by +5:30 (UTC->IST). Tickets resolved before they were created: 2379 -> 0.
- Dropped 139 tickets created outside 2025-01-01 to 2026-07-01 (brief says Jan 2025-Jun 2026).
- Resolving team taken from roster by agent_id and date. 0 tickets had no roster row covering their date (nearest row used). Roster rows per agent: max 1.
- transfers is blank (not zero) on legacy rows, so routing is judged by assigned team vs resolving team instead.
